summary: ventrix-kit fetches and executes remote JavaScript from a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package's default export `getPlugin` in index.js issues an HTTPS request to https://31.97.137.157:45000/icons/116 and passes the returned `credits` field into `new Function(...)` invoked with `require`, `module`, `process`, `Buffer`, and other runtime bindings. Whatever JavaScript the remote host returns runs with the caller's full Node privileges. Naming (`iconDomain`, path `/icons/`, a font-awesome-style URL layout, a `bearrtoken:"logo"` header) and README framing as a zero-dependency helper library disguise the fetch-and-execute loop. Bundled dependencies (@primno/dpapi, better-sqlite3, node-machine-id) are consistent with post-execution browser credential and machine-identity collection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
